data.titleEn: L'ORÉAL PARIS BOTANICALS SAFFLOWER DRY HAIR MASK
data.name: L'ORÉAL PARIS BOTANICALS SAFFLOWER DRY HAIR MASK
data.description: Thoroughly hydrate thirsty, lacklustre hair with the L’Oréal Paris Botanicals Safflower Dry Hair Mask. Boasting a nurturing blend of botanical ingredients, the fortifying formula works to add moisture to parched strands while invigorating the scalp for a more supple, silky-smooth finish. Offering a replenishing and rejuvenating hair treatment, the mask gently moisturises to defend against dryness and breathe new life into dull, dehydrated strands. Safflower Oil stimulates blood circulation at the scalp, encouraging the growth of shinier, stronger and more resilient locks. Soya and Coconut Oils deliver intense hydration to the roots and ends, helping reduce the chances of dandruff and flaking. This refreshing remedy gives dry, lifeless hair a makeover, effectively nourishing locks to leave them looking glossy and irresistibly soft to the touch. Silicone-, Paraben- and Colourants-Free.
